from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentClassificationInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted attributes for a single document to support legal cause classification."""
    document_id: str = Field(description="The identifier or title of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The primary legal domain: Civil, Criminal, or Administrative")
    cause_subject: str = Field(description="The core legal relationship or claim (e.g., 'Labor Dispute', 'Patent Infringement', 'Administrative Compensation')")
    procedural_stage: str = Field(description="The procedural phase involved: Trial, Execution, Review, etc.")
    is_execution_proceeding: bool = Field(description="Whether the document relates to enforcement/execution")
    execution_category: str | None = Field(description="If execution, the specific category: 'Criminal Property', 'Pre-emptive Execution', 'Civil General'")
    key_dispute_focus: str = Field(description="A short description of the main legal issue or dispute")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentClassificationInfo]
